summary: Comprehensive testing of Chat System and Admin Control Panel features for Breamway Auto Transport CRM. All 18 backend tests passed. Frontend tests verified Chat page (channel list, message sending, channel switching) and Admin Panel (4 tabs: API Keys, Lead Distribution, Lead Sources, API Logs).

minor.issue: Route ordering issue - was being matched by /api/leads/{lead_id} before fix
minor.status: FIXED - moved specific routes before parameterized routes

issues: Minor React warning about <span> inside <option> - cosmetic only, doesn't affect functionality

backend: GET /api/chat/channels returns channel list with All Team and DM channels
POST /api/chat/send sends message to all-team channel
Chat message flow: send -> verify in messages list
GET /api/leads/api-key returns vendor API key (superadmin only)
frontend: Chat page loads at /chat with data-testid
Channel list shows All Team (Group) and DM channels
All Team channel is selected by default
Message input and send button are functional
Sending message adds it to chat area
DM channel shows empty state when no messages
Sidebar shows Chat link with data-testid
Sidebar shows Admin Panel link (superadmin only)
Admin Panel loads at /admin with data-testid
Admin Panel has 4 tabs: API Keys, Lead Distribution, Lead Sources, API Logs
API Keys tab shows vendor key with show/hide toggle
API Keys tab has copy and regenerate buttons
API Keys tab shows sample cURL request
Lead Distribution tab shows empty state with Add Rule button
Add Rule dialog opens with agent select, source select, weight input
Lead Sources tab shows sources with counts and progress bars
API Logs tab shows empty state with refresh button

critical_code_review_comments: Route ordering fix applied: /api/leads/api-key and /api/leads/api-key/regenerate moved before /api/leads/{lead_id} to prevent path parameter matching
seed_data_creation: Created test chat messages and distribution rules during testing, cleaned up via TestCleanup class
context_for_next_testing_agent: Chat and Admin Panel features fully tested and working. Chat uses SSE for real-time messages via /api/notifications/stream. Chat channels include 'all-team' (group) and DM channels formatted as 'dm-{sorted_user_ids}'. Admin Panel is only accessible to superadmin users. API key routes were moved before parameterized routes to fix routing conflict.

chat_system.channels_endpoint: GET /api/chat/channels - returns All Team + DM channels with unread counts
chat_system.frontend: Chat page at /chat with channel list, message area, input field

api_keys_tab.ui: Show/hide toggle, copy button, regenerate button, sample cURL

lead_distribution_tab.ui: Rules table, Add Rule dialog with agent/source/weight fields

lead_sources_tab.ui: Grid of source cards with counts and progress bars

api_logs_tab.ui: Logs table with timestamp, type, source, quote number

navigation.chat_link: Visible in sidebar for all authenticated users
navigation.admin_panel_link: Visible in sidebar only for superadmin users
